title: Keep the newer three.js
author: claude
summary: We decided not to downgrade three.js, because the reflection trick we need works in this version.
what: We decided not to downgrade the three.js drawing library to an older version.
why: Box projection (a reflection trick) works in the version we have, and the light-calculating library planned for later needs a recent version.
how: A decision only: no change was needed.

tech.name: three.js
tech.plain: Draws 3D scenes in the web browser.

tech.name: Box projection
tech.plain: A trick that makes reflections line up with the real walls instead of looking infinitely far away.

tech.name: three-gpu-pathtracer
tech.plain: Planned for later: it refines the picture to photo quality when the view stops moving.
